entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I, uh, I need to make a return. My order number is VF88602.
Okay, I can help with that. Let me pull up order VF88602. I see it's for the Apex Aero Jersey. And just to be sure, I'm speaking with Sarah Miller?
Yes, that's me. I'm just so disappointed. I saved up for this, and I was really looking forward to it.
I'm sorry to hear that you're not happy with your purchase. To best help you, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

It's just the wrong size. I followed the size chart, but it's just so incredibly tight. I can barely zip it up. I've been a loyal customer for years, and this is the first time I've had a problem. I really needed the money back if it wasn't going to work out.
I understand completely, Sarah. It's frustrating when the fit isn't right. Let me check the return eligibility for you. I see you received it just five days ago.
Yes, I was hoping to maybe do an exchange for a larger size, but I was worried I'd miss the window or something.
No worries at all. I've just checked our policy, and you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. We can absolutely process a return or an exchange for you. Whichever you prefer.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I would love to exchange it for the next size up. Thank you so much.

Of course. I've just initiated the exchange process. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid shipping label to send back the jersey that's too tight. As soon as we see it's in transit, we'll ship out the larger size to you.
That's wonderful. You've been a great help, David. I was so stressed about this.
I'm happy I could resolve this for you, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
